hero.title: Web Developer
hero.intro: Frontend developer with 5 years of experience, I turn complex requirements into simple, intuitive interfaces.

iris.name: Iris
iris.subtitle: Internal AI platform
iris.description: The web application hosting Egis' internal AI product, deployed to 18,000 employees with 5,000 daily active users. Designed and developed features end-to-end.
highlights: Chat, leaderboard and gamification systems shipped end-to-end
Custom logo-based loading screens and animated badge notifications
Badge-linked challenges driving engagement at company scale

splashSections.title: Context
splashSections.body: Iris is Egis Group's internal AI assistant, built to support employees across their business use cases with an interface that adapts dynamically to the context of use.

splashSections.title: Role
splashSections.body: Frontend UI/UX developer within a team of 16. Responsible for designing and building the entire interface, with a particular focus on the chat module. Stack: React, SASS, Django, Docker, Python, JavaScript, CSS Modules.

splashSections.title: The chat
splashSections.body: Real-time streaming with an interface that adapts to the use case.
bullets: Flows: trigger pre-configured prompts with "@" in the chat input
Multi-format handling: text, images, code and documents

splashSections.title: Gamification
splashSections.body: Built challenge systems with badges, a leaderboard, and a profile featuring progression and XP.

splashSections.title: Results
splashSections.body: 5,000 daily active users, deployed to 18,000 employees across 70 countries. Winner of the FCI Awards, large enterprise category — "Étincelle d'Or".

memory.name: Memory
memory.subtitle: Projects centralization tool
memory.description: A personal product I designed and built end-to-end — from the concept and interface design down to the component implementation.
highlights: Concept, interface design and implementation, done solo
A playground for frontend architecture and animation

splashSections.title: Context
splashSections.body: An internal tool centralizing the group's engineering projects.

splashSections.title: Role
splashSections.body: Full-stack developer in charge of a large frontend scope, with integration from frontend components down to the backend. Stack: React, TypeScript, Python, Django, CSS Modules.

splashSections.title: Challenge
splashSections.body: Handling large volumes of data with project versioning and tables spanning several thousand rows — without degrading performance or user experience.

splashSections.title: Results
splashSections.body: Deployed alongside Iris. Lets engineers find every piece of company data they need in one place — a major gain in time and organization.

sustain.name: SustainEcho
sustain.subtitle: Sustainability platform
sustain.description: A platform for greener building construction. Shipped components and systems end-to-end with a strong focus on user-centric design.
highlights: Dashboard, stepper and data table built from scratch
Filtering, search and sorting across large datasets
Design system in Figma + a full visual identity redesign

splashSections.title: Context
splashSections.body: SustainEcho is a carbon optimization platform for the construction industry — a B2B startup helping construction companies find alternative, more eco-efficient materials while providing carbon assessments.

splashSections.title: Role
splashSections.body: Frontend UI/UX developer, in my final year at Epitech, within a team of about ten people. Led and fully redesigned the interface and built a complete design system. Developed components from scratch (tables, dashboards). Stack: React, JavaScript, CSS, Python, Django.

splashSections.title: Challenge
splashSections.body: First large-scale project without prior professional experience, joining a project already in progress. Rapid upskilling in a fast-paced startup environment.

splashSections.title: Results
splashSections.body: Acquired by the Egis group after one year — now commercialized under the name Emersus.

education.description: Including a fourth year abroad at UQAC (Université du Québec à Chicoutimi), Quebec — coursework in Java, AI and English.
